title: Step 3: intTest and archTest suites
scope: Add separate test, intTest and archTest suites to the spring-gradle, java-app and java-library templates of java-skeleton, all wired into check and runnable alone. spring-gradle intTest supports WireMock; a general archTest enforces the ARQ-25 layer convention with explicit layer opt-out via archTest.excludeLayers and a no-package-cycles rule. spring-gradle gains a sample HelloService. Main dependencies of every template stay unchanged.
